scope: Publishes the deterministic learner-access presentation manifest in the multilingual learner navigator and on GitHub Pages. The sidecar makes the access contract machine-readable without replacing the canonical modular-backend authority: interface locale never implies content language, authoritative originals remain prominent beside hosted readers, unavailable hosted readers remain explicit rather than fabricated, and offline status stays evidence-bound. The v0.63.13 D40 preservation payload and all prior reader/backend artifacts remain byte-preserved except for the superseded navigator. No translation is introduced by this release.
